# PartSpan

> PartSpan is an offline-first BOM (bill of materials), AVL (approved vendor list), and inventory control desktop tool for small KiCad hardware teams. All data is stored in a local SQLite database on the team's own machines; there is no hosted service.

Key facts:

- Product type: desktop application (Electron) for macOS (Apple Silicon, signed and notarized) and Windows x64 (not code-signed)
- Pricing: 14-day trial; afterwards the workspace is read-only until a license is activated (view, search, export, and backup always work). Pro US$39/year for one user (first 100 buyers US$29 for the first year). Team Local US$199/year per site for several users on one office network
- Import: the BOM CSV exported by KiCad 8 and 9 (Refs, Value, Footprint, Qty, DNP, optional IPN and MPN fields) and CSV, TSV, or XLSX with internal part number, MPN, description, quantity, reference designators, and footprint
- Core features: reference designator check (duplicates, count mismatches, invalid and missing), released BOM revisions, AVL alternates (approved / conditional / blocked) with review dates, bin-level inventory, where-used analysis, audit log, backup and restore
- Team Local: one machine shares the workspace on the office network over HTTPS (self-signed certificate with a fingerprint to verify) with viewer, editor, and admin roles; licenses activate offline
- Target users: small hardware teams (2–15 people) designing in KiCad and managing BOMs in spreadsheets
